PAT_HS_PUNCH_ref_ref_.name: Headshot Micro Punch-In with Impact Flash
PAT_HS_PUNCH_ref_ref_.description: Sudden 1.05x-1.08x camera crop zoom with a 3-frame luma flash accentuating a lethal headshot or sniper frag.
PAT_HS_PUNCH_ref_ref_.editing_technique: Micro zoom-in (scale 1.06x) for 0.12s duration, snapping back to 1.0x with cubic ease-out.
PAT_HS_PUNCH_ref_ref_.suggested_audio_treatment: Real sub downer (< 80 Hz) paired with high-frequency metal snap dink.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: MediaIn1 -> Transform1 (Size=1.06, Keyframe in 2f, out 7f) -> ColorCorrector1 (Gain=1.35) -> MediaOut1

PAT_RAMP_ref_ref_.name: Inter-Frag Speed Ramp with Directional Blur
PAT_RAMP_ref_ref_.description: Fast-forward retime (2.5x to 4.0x) covering player rotation or corridor traversal between separate kills.
PAT_RAMP_ref_ref_.editing_technique: Optical Flow speed ramp accelerating to 3.5x for 0.8s, returning to 1.0x on enemy appearance.
PAT_RAMP_ref_ref_.suggested_audio_treatment: Pitch-shifted audio whoosh + low-pass filter sweep on gameplay audio.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Speed Point at T1 (100%), Speed Point at T2 (350%), Speed Point at T3 (100%), Retime Process: Optical Flow

PAT_DROP_ref_ref_.name: 808 Beat Drop / Fatal Gunshot Synchronization
PAT_DROP_ref_ref_.description: Locking the primary musical drop (808 kick / trap snare) frame-accurately to the first lethal trigger pull.
PAT_DROP_ref_ref_.editing_technique: Timeline audio grid alignment ensuring music drop transient matches the exact weapon fire frame.
PAT_DROP_ref_ref_.suggested_audio_treatment: Sidechain gameplay audio so 808 transient dominates, weapon crack layered on top at +2.5 dB.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Audio Track 1 (CS2) Sidechained to Track 2 (Music), Ducking: -3.5dB on drop hit.

PAT_ORBIT_ref_ref_.name: Smooth Hero Orbit Climax
PAT_ORBIT_ref_ref_.description: 3rd-person circular camera path revolving 120-180 degrees around the hero to celebrate a round-winning Ace.
visual_prerequisites: Open bomb site or victory angle
PAT_ORBIT_ref_ref_.editing_technique: Slow orbital camera glide with smooth ease-in/out, keeping hero in golden ratio third.
PAT_ORBIT_ref_ref_.suggested_audio_treatment: Extended cinematic sub decay (2.5s) with fading gunshot echoes into soundtrack hook.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Node 1 (Balance) -> Node 2 (LUT) -> Node 3 (Circular Power Window on Hero + Vignette)

TRANS_WHIP_PAN_270.name: Directional Whip Pan with 270° Motion Blur
TRANS_WHIP_PAN_270.description: Rapid horizontal camera whip simulating high-speed head turn, matching movement vector between distinct scenes.
visual_prerequisites: Continuous lateral movement in source take
High contrast edges in incoming take
TRANS_WHIP_PAN_270.editing_technique: 0.20s duration transition with shutter angle set to 270° for authentic cinematic streaking.
TRANS_WHIP_PAN_270.suggested_audio_treatment: Fast air blast whoosh (whoosh_air_blast_clean.wav) peaking 2 frames before cut point.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: MediaIn1 -> DirectionalBlur (Length 0.08, Angle 180) -> Transform (CenterX anim 0.5 -> -0.5) -> Dissolve -> MediaIn2

TRANS_ZOOM_SNAP.name: Dynamic Radial Zoom-In Snap
TRANS_ZOOM_SNAP.description: Fast push-in zoom into focal point (killer or victim head) before cutting to opposite perspective.
TRANS_ZOOM_SNAP.editing_technique: 0.15s duration radial scale from 1.0x to 1.4x into cut point, incoming clip starts at 1.2x and snaps to 1.0x.
TRANS_ZOOM_SNAP.suggested_audio_treatment: Turbulent wind whip + sharp transient hit on impact frame.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Transform1 (Size 1.0 -> 1.35) -> RadialBlur (Blur 0.15) -> MediaOut

TRANS_FLASH_IMPACT.name: Luma Contrast Impact Flash
TRANS_FLASH_IMPACT.description: Overexposed 2-frame brightness burst accentuating catastrophic weapon impacts or sniper shots.
TRANS_FLASH_IMPACT.editing_technique: Gamma / Gain boosted to +35% for 2 frames at hit point, decaying over 4 frames.
TRANS_FLASH_IMPACT.suggested_audio_treatment: Sharp metallic slice cut or snap layered with sub downer.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Node 1 -> Node 2 (Gain Keyframe: f0=1.0, f2=1.45, f5=1.0) -> Output

SOUND_SUB_DOWNER_HEADSHOT.name: Low-End Sub Downer & Metallic Headshot Dink
SOUND_SUB_DOWNER_HEADSHOT.description: Deep sub-bass impact (< 70 Hz) paired with a high-frequency metal snap on lethal headshot confirmations.
visual_prerequisites: Headshot kill confirmed in combat log
SOUND_SUB_DOWNER_HEADSHOT.editing_technique: Layering Sonniss GDC impact_sub_downer_fast16.wav (-4.0 dB) with accent_flicking_metal_snap.wav (-6.0 dB).
suggested_effects: Sub harmonic synthesizer / low-pass filter @ 80 Hz
High shelf boost @ 6 kHz on dink
SOUND_SUB_DOWNER_HEADSHOT.suggested_audio_treatment: Duck music soundtrack by -3.5 dB for 150ms to allow sub transient to hit cleanly.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Fairlight Track A3 (Impacts): Level -4.0 dB, Bus 1 (Main Master)

SOUND_FAST_AIR_WHOOSH.name: Pre-Cut Fast Air Blast Whoosh
